s01.t03: A conceptual foundation for Comprehensive Ayurveda Healthcare. India, France, Portugal.
s01.t11: Brand concept, naming, brand architecture, roadmap

s02.t03: Build the conceptual foundation for an Ayurveda centre in Portugal, as part of an existing system across India and France.
s02.t04: In India, Ayurveda is a way of understanding life. In the West it was repackaged as wellness: spa treatments with pleasure and no depth. This project lives in that gap.

s03.t03: A wellness brand. A spa concept. A collection of services.

s04.t02: If health is relational, the brand must be structural.
s04.t03: A name applied on top would not hold. The brand had to work the way Ayurveda does: in relationships, never in parts.
s04.t05: The element that holds tension and creates connection. Not the centre. Not the edge. The connection between both, and the part that lets the system work as one.
s04.t06: We do not scale the person. We structure the system around her.
s04.t07: Kavitha Abzeena trained from childhood in Kerala. Her practice is never standardised, so the challenge is continuity: keeping that quality as it grows.

s05.t04: From the syllables of Kavitha's name, the ARA brand unfolds into four pillars, each with its own function and its own sub-brand.
s05.t17: Then a three-step road to opening day.
s05.t19: Identity, positioning, audiences, tone of voice and the visual system for the centres.
s05.t22: Website, social, press and internal materials, plus a toolkit for every partner who carries ARA forward.
s05.t25: The full communication strategy, then the first campaign to bring the right people through the doors.

s06.t01: The knowledge exists. The practice exists. The people exist.
